attributes.summary:
Crawl round, not a build round. It harvests what teammates shipped into the realm since the 26 Aug Quest Log round: **143 new files** (28 root modules, 16 commands, 10 components, 58 Specs, 30 instance folders) plus additive edits to Invoice, Payment, Survey and the SLA utilities.

**36 concepts moved Missing -> Implemented (source: matrix-realm)** and **40 rows were stamped with Spec facts** (the 36 plus Employment Status, Invoice Status, Payment Method and Risk Rating, which were already coded). By kit: Legal 13 (Addendum, Amendment, Case, Confidentiality/Payment/Termination Clause, Legal Entity, Clause Navigator, Contract Workspace, Legal Home, Amend/Execute Contract, Request Signature), Vendor 5 (Vendor Profile, Vendor Workspace, Onboard Vendor, Score Vendor Risk, Vendor Onboarding App), People & HR 5 (Compensation card + field, Employment Status, Hire Candidate, OKR), Real Estate 3 (Property Listing, Property Gallery, Publish Listing), and the RFQ-to-Payment money layer (Currency Registry, Money Display, Payment Terms + editor, Resolve Currency, Invoice Number, Payment Method, RFQ-to-Payment App), plus Lifecycle Dates, Waiver, Publish Survey and Reject Request. Layer 05.5 is now 83 verified of 88 coded.

**Every one of the 40 landed Adequate**, not Gold: each passes verified, example, readMe and lane, and fails consumed and reused because the crawl never stamps `consumers` (the known fifth crawl gap). Verified 285 -> 344; the +59 also folds in the 1 Sep source-classification round (POC realm retired, evidence attributed by tree on the new `source` field: 19 upgrades, 328 relabels, 63 downgrades) and the quote-to-cash Spec facts, neither of which had a report. Gold is flat at 63.

**Findings, not fixes:** (1) 143 Specs in the realm match no concept row, up from 104. The new ones are the procurement vocabulary — RFQ, Vendor Quote, Purchase Requisition, Purchase Order, Goods Receipt, Procurement Budget, PO Number/Status, RFQ Status, Budget Utilization, RFQ Comparison Board, Three-Way Match Panel, Send/Award RFQ, Receive Goods, Resolve Variance, Approve PO, Approve Invoice for Payment — a sheet-level decision to add rows or accept as app-local. (2) `Invoice/acme-enterprise-renewal-inv` fails to index: its adoptsFrom module is the bare specifier `invoice` instead of `../invoice`. (3) The daily launchd crawl round had not completed since 28 Aug — staging timeouts 29 Aug to 1 Sep, then a missing wrapper on 2 Sep because the boxel-workspaces checkout was left detached; the branch is restored and the job runs tomorrow at 07:23.
